# Avito Watch: браузер + локальный OCR + noVNC для ручного прохождения капчи.
FROM python:3.11-slim-bookworm

ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    DISPLAY=:99 \
    AW_PROFILE_DIR=/app/data/profile \
    AW_DB_PATH=/app/data/avito.db

# Системные зависимости: Xvfb + x11vnc + noVNC (чтобы вы могли пройти капчу руками
# из браузера телефона), шрифты и утилиты.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      xvfb x11vnc novnc websockify \
      fonts-liberation fonts-dejavu-core \
      ca-certificates curl tini procps \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt requirements-ocr.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-ocr.txt || \
       echo "OCR-пакеты не установились — капча-картинка будет решаться вручную"

# Браузер и его системные зависимости
RUN playwright install --with-deps chromium && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY avito_watch ./avito_watch
COPY config.example.yaml ./config.example.yaml
COPY docker/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh && mkdir -p /app/data

VOLUME ["/app/data"]
EXPOSE 6080

HEALTHCHECK --interval=60s --timeout=10s --start-period=90s --retries=3 \
  CMD python -c "import json,time,sys; d=json.load(open('/app/data/heartbeat.json')); sys.exit(0 if time.time()-d['ts'] < 300 else 1)" || exit 1

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "--", "/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["python", "-m", "avito_watch", "run"]########## docker-compose.yml

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Запуск Avito Watch в контейнере.
# По умолчанию браузер работает «headed» внутри виртуального дисплея Xvfb:
# так вы в любой момент можете открыть noVNC и пройти капчу руками.
set -euo pipefail

APP_DIR="${APP_DIR:-/app}"
cd "$APP_DIR"
mkdir -p data data/profile data/captcha

if [[ ! -f config.yaml ]]; then
  cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
  echo "[entrypoint] Создан config.yaml из примера — отредактируйте sources под себя"
fi

HEADLESS="${AW_HEADLESS:-0}"
VNC_PORT="${VNC_PORT:-6080}"
VNC_PASSWORD="${VNC_PASSWORD:-}"

if [[ "$HEADLESS" == "0" || "$HEADLESS" == "false" ]]; then
  echo "[entrypoint] Поднимаю виртуальный дисплей :99"
  Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1440x900x24 -nolisten tcp &
  sleep 2

  VNC_ARGS=(-display :99 -forever -shared -rfbport 5900 -noxdamage -quiet)
  if [[ -n "$VNC_PASSWORD" ]]; then
    VNC_ARGS+=(-passwd "$VNC_PASSWORD")
  else
    echo "[entrypoint] ВНИМАНИЕ: VNC без пароля. Задайте VNC_PASSWORD в .env или закройте порт наружу."
    VNC_ARGS+=(-nopw)
  fi
  x11vnc "${VNC_ARGS[@]}" &
  sleep 1

  websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc "$VNC_PORT" localhost:5900 &
  echo "[entrypoint] noVNC: http://localhost:${VNC_PORT}/vnc.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale"
  export DISPLAY=:99
else
  echo "[entrypoint] Headless-режим: ручное прохождение капчи через noVNC недоступно"
fi

# Чистим зависший лок профиля после некорректной остановки контейнера
rm -f data/profile/SingletonLock data/profile/SingletonCookie data/profile/SingletonSocket 2>/dev/null || true

exec "$@"########## .env.example

    return str(value).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on", "да")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None or value == "":

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):

@dataclass
class StorageConfig:
    db_path: str = "data/avito.db"
    captcha_dir: str = "data/captcha"
    keep_raw_json: bool = True
    vacuum_every_hours: int = 24


@dataclass
class LoggingConfig:
    level: str = "INFO"
    file: str = "data/avito-watch.log"
    max_bytes: int = 5_000_000
    backups: int = 3
    json: bool = False


@dataclass
class Config:
    telegram: TelegramConfig = field(default_factory=TelegramConfig)
    browser: BrowserConfig = field(default_factory=BrowserConfig)
    captcha: CaptchaConfig = field(default_factory=CaptchaConfig)
    watch: WatchConfig = field(default_factory=WatchConfig)
    storage: StorageConfig = field(default_factory=StorageConfig)
    logging: LoggingConfig = field(default_factory=LoggingConfig)
    sources: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    config_path: str = "config.yaml"

    # ---------- загрузка ----------
    @classmethod
    def load(cls, path: str | Path | None = None) -> "Config":
        cfg = cls()
        path = Path(path or _env("AW_CONFIG", "config.yaml"))
        cfg.config_path = str(path)
        if path.exists():
            data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValueError(f"{path}: ожидался YAML-словарь")
            cfg._apply_dict(data)
        cfg._apply_env()
        cfg._normalize()
        return cfg

    def _apply_dict(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        for f in fields(self):
            if f.name not in data:
                continue
            value = data[f.name]
            current = getattr(self, f.name)
            if is_dataclass(current) and isinstance(value, dict):
                _fill_dataclass(current, value)
            else:
                setattr(self, f.name, value)

    def _apply_env(self) -> None:
        t, b, c, w, s, lg = (self.telegram, self.browser, self.captcha,
                             self.watch, self.storage, self.logging)
        # секреты — только из окружения/.env, в YAML их лучше не хранить
        t.bot_token = _env("AW_TELEGRAM_TOKEN", _env("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN", t.bot_token)) or ""
        t.chat_id = str(_env("AW_CHAT_ID", _env("TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID", t.chat_id)) or "")
        t.admin_ids = _as_list(_env("AW_ADMIN_IDS", t.admin_ids)) or t.admin_ids
        t.enabled = _as_bool(_env("AW_TELEGRAM_ENABLED", t.enabled))
        b.headless = _as_bool(_env("AW_HEADLESS", b.headless))
        b.proxy = _env("AW_PROXY", b.proxy) or ""
        b.engine = _env("AW_ENGINE", b.engine) or b.engine
        b.cdp_endpoint = _env("AW_CDP_ENDPOINT", b.cdp_endpoint) or ""
        b.user_data_dir = _env("AW_PROFILE_DIR", b.user_data_dir) or b.user_data_dir
        c.auto_solve = _as_bool(_env("AW_CAPTCHA_AUTO", c.auto_solve))
        c.ocr_backend = _env("AW_OCR_BACKEND", c.ocr_backend) or c.ocr_backend
        c.manual_url = _env("AW_MANUAL_URL", c.manual_url) or ""
        c.manual_wait_sec = int(_env("AW_CAPTCHA_MANUAL_WAIT", c.manual_wait_sec))
        w.default_interval_sec = int(_env("AW_INTERVAL", w.default_interval_sec))
        w.pages_per_source = int(_env("AW_PAGES", w.pages_per_source))
        w.enrich_items = _as_bool(_env("AW_ENRICH", w.enrich_items))
        w.seed_existing = _as_bool(_env("AW_SEED_EXISTING", w.seed_existing))
        s.db_path = _env("AW_DB_PATH", s.db_path) or s.db_path
        lg.level = _env("AW_LOG_LEVEL", lg.level) or lg.level

    def _normalize(self) -> None:
        t = self.telegram
        if not t.admin_ids and t.chat_id:
            t.admin_ids = [t.chat_id]
        t.admin_ids = [str(x) for x in t.admin_ids]
        self.watch.default_interval_sec = max(15, int(self.watch.default_interval_sec))
        self.watch.pages_per_source = max(1, min(20, int(self.watch.pages_per_source)))
        self.watch.max_concurrent_pages = max(1, int(self.watch.max_concurrent_pages))
        self.captcha.max_auto_attempts = max(0, int(self.captcha.max_auto_attempts))
        for p in (self.storage.db_path, self.logging.file):
            Path(p).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(self.storage.captcha_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(self.browser.user_data_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ---------- проверки ----------
    def validate(self) -> list[str]:
        problems: list[str] = []
        if self.telegram.enabled:
            if not self.telegram.bot_token:
                problems.append("Не задан AW_TELEGRAM_TOKEN (токен бота от @BotFather)")
            elif ":" not in self.telegram.bot_token:
                problems.append("AW_TELEGRAM_TOKEN выглядит некорректно (ожидается '123456:ABC...')")
            if not self.telegram.chat_id:
                problems.append("Не задан AW_CHAT_ID (напишите боту /start — он покажет ваш chat_id)")
        if self.watch.default_interval_sec < self.watch.min_interval_sec:
            problems.append(
                f"Интервал {self.watch.default_interval_sec}с меньше рекомендованного "
                f"{self.watch.min_interval_sec}с — Авито начнёт показывать капчу чаще"
            )
        if self.browser.engine == "http":
            problems.append("engine=http: файрвол Авито (proof-of-work) требует JS; "
                            "режим годится только для прогрева сессии браузером")
        return problems

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def conv(obj: Any) -> Any:
            if is_dataclass(obj):
                return {f.name: conv(getattr(obj, f.name)) for f in fields(obj)}
            if isinstance(obj, list):
                return [conv(v) for v in obj]
            return obj
        data = conv(self)
        if data.get("telegram", {}).get("bot_token"):
            data["telegram"]["bot_token"] = "***"
        if data.get("browser", {}).get("proxy"):
            data["browser"]["proxy"] = "***"
        return data


def _fill_dataclass(obj: Any, data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    known = {f.name: f for f in fields(obj)}
    for key, value in data.items():
        if key not in known:
            continue
        current = getattr(obj, key)
        if is_dataclass(current) and isinstance(value, dict):
            _fill_dataclass(current, value)
        elif known[key].type in ("list[str]", list) or isinstance(current, list):
            setattr(obj, key, _as_list(value))
        elif isinstance(current, bool):
            setattr(obj, key, _as_bool(value))
        elif isinstance(current, int) and not isinstance(current, bool):
            setattr(obj, key, int(value))
        elif isinstance(current, float):
            setattr(obj, key, float(value))
        else:
            setattr(obj, key, value)


def load_dotenv(path: str | Path = ".env") -> None:
    """Мини-загрузчик .env без внешних зависимостей (не перетирает уже заданные переменные)."""
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        return
    for line in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if line.lower().startswith("export "):
            line = line[7:]
        if "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\"")
        os.environ.setdefault(key, value)

""" CONTENT = "content" # нормальная выдача/карточка EMPTY = "empty" # честная пустая выдача — не ошибка CHALLENGE = "challenge" # proof-of-work (HTTP 439), браузер пройдёт сам CAPTCHA = "captcha" # файрвол показал капчу (.js-firewall-form) BLOCKED = "blocked" # «подождите немного и обновите страницу» — нужен новый IP UNKNOWN = "unknown" # непонятно, имеет смысл повторить class CaptchaVariant(str, enum.Enum): GEETEST = "geetest" # GeeTest v4, пазл со слайдером IMAGE = "image" # собственная капча-картинка Авито (#inner-captcha) HCAPTCHA = "hcaptcha" # hCaptcha (#h-captcha) NONE = "none" class SourceStatus(str, enum.Enum): ACTIVE = "active" PAUSED = "paused" CAPTCHA = "captcha" # ждём ручного решения ERROR = "error" @dataclass(slots=True) class Listing: """Одно объявление. Всё, что просил пользователь: фото, ссылка, дата, описание, цена.""" item_id: str url: str title: str = "" price: int | None = None price_text: str = "" currency: str = "RUB" old_price: int | None = None discount_pct: int | None = None image_url: str | None = None images: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) description: str | None = None published_at: datetime | None = None published_raw: str | None = None location: str | None = None seller_name: str | None = None seller_type: str | None = None params: str | None = None source_id: int | None = None price_source: str = "unknown" # state | dom | item raw: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict) @property def is_complete(self) -> bool: """Достаточно ли данных для уведомления без захода на страницу объявления.""" return bool(self.title and self.image_url and (self.price is not None or self.price_text)) @dataclass(slots=True) class Source: """Одна отслеживаемая ссылка (поиск/категория) со своим интервалом.""" id: int url: str name: str = "" interval_sec: int = 300 pages: int = 1 status: str = SourceStatus.ACTIVE.value seed_existing: bool = True min_price: int | None = None max_price: int | None = None keywords_include: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) keywords_exclude: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) last_check_at: float | None = None next_check_at: float = 0.0 last_error: str | None = None consecutive_errors: int = 0 found_total: int = 0 notified_total: int = 0 created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time) @property def label(self) -> str: return self.name or f"#{self.id}" @dataclass(slots=True) class FetchResult: """Ответ движка загрузки страницы.""" url: str html: str status: int = 200 state: PageState = PageState.UNKNOWN engine: str = "browser" elapsed: float = 0.0 error: str | None = None @property def ok(self) -> bool: return self.state in (PageState.CONTENT, PageState.EMPTY) @dataclass(slots=True) class CaptchaChallenge: """Описание капчи, которую нужно решить.""" variant: CaptchaVariant page_url: str captcha_id: str | None = None sitekey: str | None = None image_bytes: bytes | None = None screenshot: bytes | None = None detected_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time) @dataclass(slots=True) class SolveResult: solved: bool method: str = "none" # ocr-local | slider-cv | manual | skipped attempts: int = 0 detail: str = "" answer: str | None = None"""Конвейер одного цикла: загрузка выдачи → дедупликация → обогащение → Telegram.""" from __future__ import annotations import asyncio import logging import time from dataclasses import dataclass, field from .config import Config from .db import Database from .engine.base import Engine from .models import Listing, PageState, Source from .notify.telegram import Telegram from .parser.listing import next_page_url, parse_listing from .parser.item import parse_item from .utils import asleep, clean_text, jitter, strip_tracking log = logging.getLogger(__name__) @dataclass class CycleReport: source_id: int label: str state: PageState = PageState.UNKNOWN found: int = 0 new: int = 0 notified: int = 0 price_drops: int = 0 filtered: int = 0 enriched: int = 0 seeded: int = 0 error: str | None = None pages_read: int = 0 duration: float = 0.0 details: list[str] = field(default_factory=list) @property def ok(self) -> bool: return self.state in (PageState.CONTENT, PageState.EMPTY) and not self.error class Pipeline: def __init__(self, cfg: Config, db: Database, engine: Engine, telegram: Telegram, solver=None): self.cfg = cfg self.db = db self.engine = engine self.telegram = telegram self.solver = solver # ------------------------------------------------------------------ main async def check_source(self, source: Source) -> CycleReport: started = time.time() report = CycleReport(source_id=source.id, label=source.label) collected: dict[str, Listing] = {} for page_num in range(1, max(1, source.pages) + 1): url = strip_tracking(source.url) if page_num == 1 else next_page_url(source.url, page_num) result = await self.engine.fetch(url, source_id=source.id, captcha_handler=self.solver) report.state = result.state report.pages_read += 1 if result.error: report.error = result.error if not result.ok: report.details.append(f"стр.{page_num}: {result.state.value}") break listings = parse_listing(result.html, source_id=source.id, page_url=url) fresh = [l for l in listings if l.item_id not in collected] for listing in listings: collected.setdefault(listing.item_id, listing) report.found += len(listings) if not listings or (page_num > 1 and not fresh): break if page_num < source.pages: await asleep(jitter(self.cfg.browser.page_delay_sec)) report.found = len(collected) if not report.ok: report.duration = time.time() - started return report candidates = [l for l in collected.values() if self._passes_filters(l, source)] report.filtered = len(collected) - len(candidates) # первый проход по источнику: только фиксируем, чтобы не прислать 50 старых объявлений seed_key = f"seeded:{source.id}" if source.seed_existing and self.db.get_meta(seed_key) != "1": for listing in candidates: self.db.upsert_listing(listing, mark_seen_only=True) self.db.set_meta(seed_key, "1") self.db.update_source(source.id, seed_existing=False) report.seeded = len(candidates) report.new = 0 await self.telegram.send_text( f"📌 Источник {source.label} подключён.\n" f"Зафиксировал {len(candidates)} существующих объявлений — они не придут в чат.\n" f"Дальше присылаю только новые. Интервал: {source.interval_sec} с.") report.duration = time.time() - started return report new_listings: list[Listing] = [] drops: list[tuple[Listing, int]] = [] for listing in candidates: previous = self.db.get_listing(listing.item_id) old_price = previous.price if previous else None outcome = self.db.upsert_listing(listing) if outcome == "new": new_listings.append(listing) elif outcome == "price_drop" and self.cfg.telegram.notify_price_drop: if old_price and listing.price is not None: pct = (1 - listing.price / old_price) * 100 if pct >= self.cfg.telegram.price_drop_min_pct: drops.append((listing, old_price)) report.new = len(new_listings) report.price_drops = len(drops) self.db.bump_source_counters(source.id, found=report.new) # обогащение: описание и точная дата живут на странице объявления limit = self.cfg.watch.enrich_max_per_cycle if self.cfg.watch.enrich_items and new_listings and limit > 0: for listing in new_listings[:limit]: await asleep(jitter(self.cfg.watch.enrich_delay_sec)) enriched = await self._enrich(listing) if enriched: report.enriched += 1 # отправка send_limit = self.cfg.watch.max_new_per_cycle for listing in new_listings[:send_limit]: stored = self.db.get_listing(listing.item_id) or listing ok = await self.telegram.send_listing(stored, source_label=source.label, kind="new") if ok: self.db.mark_notified(listing.item_id) report.notified += 1 else: self.db.mark_notified(listing.item_id, error="telegram send failed") if len(new_listings) > send_limit: report.details.append(f"отложено {len(new_listings) - send_limit} объявлений (лимит цикла)") for listing, old_price in drops[:send_limit]: stored = self.db.get_listing(listing.item_id) or listing await self.telegram.send_listing(stored, source_label=source.label, kind="price_drop", old_price=old_price) self.db.bump_source_counters(source.id, notified=report.notified) report.duration = time.time() - started log.info("Цикл %s: найдено=%d новых=%d отправлено=%d снижений_цены=%d (%.1fs)", source.label, report.found, report.new, report.notified, report.price_drops, report.duration) return report # ------------------------------------------------------------------ enrich async def _enrich(self, listing: Listing) -> bool: try: result = await self.engine.fetch(listing.url, is_item=True, source_id=listing.source_id, captcha_handler=self.solver) except Exception as exc: log.warning("Обогащение %s: %s", listing.url, exc) return False if not result.ok: log.info("Обогащение %s пропущено: %s", listing.url, result.state.value) return False item = parse_item(result.html, url=listing.url) if item is None: return False merged = Listing( item_id=listing.item_id, url=listing.url, title=item.title or listing.title, price=item.price if item.price is not None else listing.price, price_text=item.price_text or listing.price_text, currency=listing.currency, old_price=item.old_price if item.old_price is not None else listing.old_price, discount_pct=item.discount_pct if item.discount_pct is not None else listing.discount_pct, image_url=item.image_url or listing.image_url, images=item.images or listing.images, description=item.description or listing.description, published_at=item.published_at or listing.published_at, published_raw=item.published_raw or listing.published_raw, location=item.location or listing.location, seller_name=item.seller_name or listing.seller_name, seller_type=item.seller_type or listing.seller_type, params=item.params or listing.params, source_id=listing.source_id, price_source=item.price_source if item.price is not None else listing.price_source, ) self.db.upsert_listing(merged) self.db.mark_enriched(listing.item_id) return True # ------------------------------------------------------------------ filters def _passes_filters(self, listing: Listing, source: Source) -> bool: if source.min_price is not None and listing.price is not None and listing.price < source.min_price: return False if source.max_price is not None and listing.price is not None and listing.price > source.max_price: return False haystack = f"{listing.title} {clean_text(listing.description or '')}".lower() if source.keywords_include and not any(k.lower() in haystack for k in source.keywords_include): return False if source.keywords_exclude and any(k.lower() in haystack for k in source.keywords_exclude): return False return True # ------------------------------------------------------------------ backlog async def flush_backlog(self) -> int: if not self.cfg.watch.notify_backlog: return 0 pending = self.db.pending_notifications(limit=self.cfg.watch.max_new_per_cycle) sent = 0 for listing in pending: source = self.db.get_source(listing.source_id) if listing.source_id else None ok = await self.telegram.send_listing(listing, source_label=source.label if source else "") if ok: self.db.mark_notified(listing.item_id) sent += 1 else: break if sent: log.info("Дослал %d объявлений из очереди", sent) return sent

"""Локальное CV для слайдер-капчи (GeeTest v4): ищем, куда двигать пазл.

Никаких внешних сервисов — только OpenCV на вашей машине:
  * template — сопоставление контуров кусочка и фона (точнее, если кусочек виден);
  * edge     — поиск «выемки» по вертикальным границам, когда кусочка нет.

Важно: найденное смещение — только половина дела. GeeTest оценивает ещё и
поведение (траекторию, тайминги, отпечаток). Поэтому автопопытка ограничена,
а при неудаче управление уходит человеку с уведомлением в Telegram.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GapResult:
    x: float                  # координата левого края выемки в пикселях картинки фона
    confidence: float         # 0..1
    method: str
    bg_width: int
    piece_width: int
    piece_x: float = 0.0      # текущее положение кусочка на картинке фона

    @property
    def distance(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.x - self.piece_x)

    def to_css(self, css_width: float) -> float:
        """Пересчёт смещения из пикселей картинки в CSS-пиксели элемента."""
        if self.bg_width <= 0 or css_width <= 0:
            return self.distance
        return self.distance * (css_width / self.bg_width)


def _decode(png: bytes):
    import cv2
    import numpy as np
    arr = np.frombuffer(png, dtype="uint8")
    return cv2.imdecode(arr, cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)


def _gray(image):
    import cv2
    if image is None:
        return None
    if image.ndim == 2:
        return image
    if image.shape[2] == 4:
        return cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGRA2GRAY)
    return cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)


def _alpha_bbox(image):
    """Обрезка кусочка по альфа-каналу: у PNG пазла фон прозрачный."""
    import cv2
    import numpy as np
    if image is None or image.ndim != 3 or image.shape[2] != 4:
        return image, None
    alpha = image[:, :, 3]
    ys, xs = np.where(alpha > 32)
    if len(xs) == 0:
        return image, None
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = int(xs.min()), int(xs.max()) + 1, int(ys.min()), int(ys.max()) + 1
    crop = image[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    mask = (crop[:, :, 3] > 32).astype("uint8") * 255
    return crop, mask


def find_gap(bg_png: bytes, piece_png: bytes | None = None, *, method: str = "auto") -> GapResult | None:
    try:
        import cv2
        import numpy as np
    except ImportError:
        log.info("OpenCV не установлен — авто-решение слайдера недоступно (pip install opencv-python-headless)")
        return None

    bg = _decode(bg_png)
    if bg is None:
        return None
    bg_gray = _gray(bg)
    bg_h, bg_w = bg_gray.shape[:2]

    if piece_png and method in ("auto", "template"):
        result = _template_match(bg_gray, piece_png)
        if result is not None and (result.confidence >= 0.35 or method == "template"):
            return result
    if method in ("auto", "edge"):
        return _edge_search(bg_gray)
    return None


def _template_match(bg_gray, piece_png: bytes) -> GapResult | None:
    import cv2
    import numpy as np

    piece = _decode(piece_png)
    if piece is None:
        return None
    piece_crop, mask = _alpha_bbox(piece)
    piece_gray = _gray(piece_crop)
    if piece_gray is None:
        return None

    bg_h, bg_w = bg_gray.shape[:2]
    ph, pw = piece_gray.shape[:2]
    if ph < 8 or pw < 8 or ph > bg_h or pw > bg_w:
        # кусочек пришёл в другом масштабе — приводим к высоте фона
        scale = bg_h / max(ph, 1)
        if 0.2 < scale < 5:
            piece_gray = cv2.resize(piece_gray, (max(8, int(pw * scale)), max(8, int(ph * scale))))
            if mask is not None:
                mask = cv2.resize(mask, piece_gray.shape[::-1])
            ph, pw = piece_gray.shape[:2]
        if ph > bg_h or pw > bg_w:
            return None

    bg_edges = cv2.Canny(cv2.GaussianBlur(bg_gray, (3, 3), 0), 60, 160)
    piece_edges = cv2.Canny(cv2.GaussianBlur(piece_gray, (3, 3), 0), 60, 160)

    if mask is not None:
        piece_edges = cv2.bitwise_and(piece_edges, piece_edges, mask=mask)
        response = cv2.matchTemplate(bg_edges, piece_edges, cv2.TM_CCORR_NORMED, mask=mask)
    else:
        response = cv2.matchTemplate(bg_edges, piece_edges, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    response = np.nan_to_num(response, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    # выемка не может быть левее исходного положения кусочка
    min_x = max(1, int(pw * 0.9))
    if min_x < response.shape[1]:
        response[:, :min_x] = -1.0
    _, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(response)
    if max_val <= 0:
        return None
    return GapResult(x=float(max_loc[0]), confidence=float(max(0.0, min(1.0, max_val))),
                     method="template", bg_width=bg_w, piece_width=pw, piece_x=0.0)


def _edge_search(bg_gray) -> GapResult | None:
    """Ищем пару вертикальных границ на расстоянии «ширины пазла» друг от друга."""
    import cv2
    import numpy as np

    bg_h, bg_w = bg_gray.shape[:2]
    blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(bg_gray, (5, 5), 0)
    sobel = cv2.Sobel(blur, cv2.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize=3)
    profile = np.abs(sobel).mean(axis=0)
    if profile.max() <= 0:
        return None
    profile = profile / profile.max()
    kernel = np.ones(3) / 3
    profile = np.convolve(profile, kernel, mode="same")

    start = int(bg_w * 0.25)          # слева обычно стоит сам кусочек
    candidates = []
    for width in range(max(24, int(bg_w * 0.10)), max(40, int(bg_w * 0.28))):
        for x in range(start, bg_w - width - 2):
            left, right = profile[x], profile[x + width]
            inner = profile[x + 4:x + width - 4].mean() if width > 10 else 0.0
            score = (left + right) / 2 - 0.55 * inner
            candidates.append((score, x, width, min(left, right)))
    if not candidates:
        return None
    candidates.sort(reverse=True)
    score, x, width, strength = candidates[0]
    confidence = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, 0.45 * score + 0.55 * strength)))
    return GapResult(x=float(x), confidence=confidence, method="edge",
                     bg_width=bg_w, piece_width=width, piece_x=0.0)"""Локальное CV слайдера и человеческая траектория."""

    ok, bg_png = cv2.imencode(".png", bg)
    ok2, piece_png = cv2.imencode(".png", piece_img)
    assert ok and ok2
    return bg_png.tobytes(), piece_png.tobytes(), gap_x, piece

def test_human_track_shape():
    points = human_track(100.0, 200.0, 180.0, duration=1.0)
    assert len(points) > 30
    assert abs(points[-1].x - 280.0) < 0.5           # пришли точно в цель
    assert abs(points[-1].y - 200.0) < 0.5
    # есть перелёт
    assert max(p.x for p in points) > 281.0
    # движение неравномерное: первый шаг меньше последнего «разгона»
    deltas = [points[i].x - points[i - 1].x for i in range(1, len(points))]
    assert max(deltas) > 3 * min(abs(d) for d in deltas if d > 0)
    # дрожание по Y присутствует
    assert any(abs(p.y - 200.0) > 0.1 for p in points[:-1])
    assert sum(p.delay for p in points) > 0.5


def test_track_is_not_linear():
    points = human_track(0.0, 0.0, 200.0, duration=1.2)
    xs = [p.x for p in points]
    linear = [200 * (i + 1) / len(xs) for i in range(len(xs))]
    deviation = sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(xs, linear)) / len(xs)
    assert deviation > 5, "траектория слишком похожа на равномерное движение бота"

"""Планировщик: несколько ссылок, у каждой свой интервал, джиттер и бэкофф.

Один браузер, одна страница за раз: Авито считает частоту запросов по IP,
параллелить выгоднее прокси, а не потоками.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import json
import logging
import time
from pathlib import Path

from .config import Config
from .db import Database
from .engine.base import Engine
from .models import PageState, Source, SourceStatus
from .notify.telegram import Telegram
from .pipeline import CycleReport, Pipeline
from .utils import jitter

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

HEARTBEAT_PATH = Path("data/heartbeat.json")


class Watcher:
    def __init__(self, cfg: Config, db: Database, engine: Engine, telegram: Telegram,
                 pipeline: Pipeline, *, manual=None, solver=None):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.db = db
        self.engine = engine
        self.telegram = telegram
        self.pipeline = pipeline
        self.manual = manual
        self.solver = solver
        self._stop = asyncio.Event()
        self._tasks: list[asyncio.Task] = []
        self.cycles = 0
        self.started_at = 0.0
        self.last_report: CycleReport | None = None
        self.paused_globally = False

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ lifecycle
    async def run(self) -> None:
        self.started_at = time.time()
        await self.engine.start()
        await self.telegram.start()
        await self.pipeline.flush_backlog()
        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat_loop(), name="heartbeat"))
        try:
            await self._loop()
        finally:
            await self.shutdown()

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()
        for task in self._tasks:
            task.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
        self._tasks.clear()
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await self.engine.stop()
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await self.telegram.close()
        self.db.close()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop.set()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ loop
    async def _loop(self) -> None:
        while not self._stop.is_set():
            if self.paused_globally:
                await self._sleep(5)
                continue
            due = self.db.due_sources()
            if not due:
                await self._sleep(self._next_wait())
                continue
            for source in due:
                if self._stop.is_set():
                    break
                await self._run_source(source)
            await self._sleep(1)

    def _next_wait(self) -> float:
        sources = [s for s in self.db.list_sources() if s.status == SourceStatus.ACTIVE.value]
        if not sources:
            return 10.0
        delta = min(s.next_check_at for s in sources) - time.time()
        return max(1.0, min(delta, 30.0))

    async def _sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            await asyncio.wait_for(self._stop.wait(), timeout=max(0.5, seconds))

    async def _run_source(self, source: Source) -> CycleReport:
        log.info("Проверяю источник %s (%s)", source.label, source.url)
        try:
            report = await self.pipeline.check_source(source)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.exception("Цикл источника %s упал", source.label)
            report = CycleReport(source_id=source.id, label=source.label,
                                 state=PageState.UNKNOWN, error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
        self.cycles += 1
        self.last_report = report
        self._reschedule(source, report)
        return report

    def _reschedule(self, source: Source, report: CycleReport) -> None:
        wcfg = self.cfg.watch
        now = time.time()
        errors = source.consecutive_errors
        status = SourceStatus.ACTIVE.value
        delay = jitter(source.interval_sec or wcfg.default_interval_sec, wcfg.interval_jitter)
        error_text = report.error

        if report.state is PageState.CAPTCHA:
            error_text = "капча не решена"
            delay = max(delay, wcfg.error_backoff_sec)
            if self.cfg.captcha.pause_source_on_captcha:
                status = SourceStatus.CAPTCHA.value
        elif report.state is PageState.BLOCKED:
            error_text = "файрвол: «подождите немного» — нужен другой IP"
            delay = max(delay, wcfg.blocked_backoff_sec)
            errors += 1
        elif report.state is PageState.CHALLENGE:
            error_text = "proof-of-work не завершился"
            delay = max(delay, wcfg.error_backoff_sec)
            errors += 1
        elif report.error:
            errors += 1
            delay = min(wcfg.error_backoff_max_sec,
                        max(delay, wcfg.error_backoff_sec * (2 ** min(errors - 1, 4))))
        else:
            errors = 0
            error_text = None

        self.db.update_source(source.id, last_check_at=now, next_check_at=now + delay,
                              status=status, consecutive_errors=errors, last_error=error_text)
        if status == SourceStatus.CAPTCHA.value:
            log.warning("Источник %s на паузе из-за капчи (/resume %d)", source.label, source.id)
        else:
            log.info("Следующая проверка %s через %.0f с", source.label, delay)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ heartbeat
    async def _heartbeat_loop(self) -> None:
        while not self._stop.is_set():
            payload = {
                "ts": time.time(),
                "uptime_sec": round(time.time() - self.started_at, 1),
                "cycles": self.cycles,
                "paused": self.paused_globally,
                "engine": await self.engine.health(),
                "captcha": self.solver.stats() if self.solver else {},
                "telegram": {"sent": self.telegram.sent_count, "errors": self.telegram.error_count},
                "stats": self.db.stats(),
                "sources": [
                    {"id": s.id, "label": s.label, "status": s.status,
                     "next_in_sec": round(max(0.0, s.next_check_at - time.time())),
                     "interval_sec": s.interval_sec, "last_error": s.last_error}
                    for s in self.db.list_sources()
                ],
            }
            try:
                HEARTBEAT_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                HEARTBEAT_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                                          encoding="utf-8")
            except OSError as exc:
                log.debug("heartbeat: %s", exc)
            await self._sleep(self.cfg.watch.watchdog_sec)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ manual ops
    async def check_now(self, source_id: int) -> CycleReport | None:
        source = self.db.get_source(source_id)
        if source is None:
            return None
        return await self._run_source(source)

    def resume_source(self, source_id: int) -> bool:
        source = self.db.get_source(source_id)
        if source is None:
            return False
        self.db.update_source(source_id, status=SourceStatus.ACTIVE.value, next_check_at=0,
                              consecutive_errors=0, last_error=None)
        return True

    def pause_source(self, source_id: int) -> bool:
        if self.db.get_source(source_id) is None:
            return False
        self.db.update_source(source_id, status=SourceStatus.PAUSED.value)
        return True

    def sync_config_sources(self) -> int:
        """Добавляет ссылки из config.yaml (существующие не дублируются)."""
        added = 0
        for entry in self.cfg.sources:
            if isinstance(entry, str):
                entry = {"url": entry}
            url = (entry.get("url") or "").strip()
            if not url:
                continue
            existing = next((s for s in self.db.list_sources() if s.url == url), None)
            if existing:
                continue
            self.db.add_source(
                url,
                name=entry.get("name", ""),
                interval_sec=int(entry.get("interval_sec", self.cfg.watch.default_interval_sec)),
                pages=int(entry.get("pages", self.cfg.watch.pages_per_source)),
                seed_existing=bool(entry.get("seed_existing", self.cfg.watch.seed_existing)),
                min_price=entry.get("min_price"),
                max_price=entry.get("max_price"),
                keywords_include=entry.get("keywords_include") or [],
                keywords_exclude=entry.get("keywords_exclude") or [],
            )
            added += 1
        return added"""Абстракция движка загрузки страниц.

Нужна, чтобы парсер, планировщик и решатель капчи не зависели от Playwright
и чтобы тесты могли подставить фейковый движок без браузера и сети.
"""

CaptchaHandler = Callable[[PageAdapter, int | None], Awaitable[SolveResult]]

                    captcha_handler: CaptchaHandler | None = None) -> FetchResult: ...

    async def save_session(self, path: str) -> None:
        return None

    async def health(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

"""Движок на Playwright.

Почему браузер, а не requests: файрвол Авито отдаёт страницу proof-of-work
(HTTP 439), которую проходит только JS. Плюс сессия (cookies файрвола) должна
жить между запусками — поэтому persistent context, а не новый браузер каждый раз.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import os
import random
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from ..config import BrowserConfig
from ..models import FetchResult, PageState
from ..parser.state import detect_state
from .base import CaptchaHandler, Engine, PageAdapter
from .stealth import HUMANIZE_JS, STEALTH_JS

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_BLOCKED_TYPES = {"image", "media", "font"}
_DEFAULT_ARGS = [
    "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
    "--no-first-run",
    "--no-default-browser-check",
    "--disable-dev-shm-usage",
    "--disable-background-timer-throttling",
    "--disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows",
    "--disable-renderer-backgrounding",
    "--metrics-recording-only",
    "--no-service-autorun",
    "--password-store=basic",
    "--lang=ru-RU",
]


class PlaywrightPage(PageAdapter):
    """Живая страница: нужна решателям капчи (скриншоты, клики, drag, evaluate)."""

    supports_interaction = True

    def __init__(self, page: Any):
        self._page = page

    @property
    def raw(self) -> Any:
        return self._page

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        try:
            return self._page.url
        except Exception:
            return ""

    async def html(self) -> str:
        for _ in range(3):
            try:
                return await self._page.content()
            except Exception as exc:  # page is navigating
                log.debug("content() во время навигации: %s", exc)
                await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
        return ""

    async def screenshot(self, *, full_page: bool = False) -> bytes | None:
        try:
            return await self._page.screenshot(full_page=full_page, type="png", timeout=15000)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.warning("Не удалось сделать скриншот: %s", exc)
            return None

    async def element_screenshot(self, selector: str) -> bytes | None:
        try:
            el = await self._page.query_selector(selector)
            if not el:
                return None
            return await el.screenshot(type="png", timeout=10000)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("element_screenshot(%s): %s", selector, exc)
            return None

    async def evaluate(self, script: str, arg: Any = None) -> Any:
        try:
            return await self._page.evaluate(script, arg)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("evaluate: %s", exc)
            return None

    async def bounding_box(self, selector: str) -> dict[str, float] | None:
        try:
            el = await self._page.query_selector(selector)
            if not el:
                return None
            return await el.bounding_box()
        except Exception:
            return None

    async def is_visible(self, selector: str) -> bool:
        try:
            el = await self._page.query_selector(selector)
            return bool(el and await el.is_visible())
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def click(self, selector: str) -> bool:
        try:
            el = await self._page.query_selector(selector)
            if not el or not await el.is_visible():
                return False
            box = await el.bounding_box()
            if box:
                # клик не в центр, а в случайную точку внутри элемента
                x = box["x"] + box["width"] * random.uniform(0.3, 0.7)
                y = box["y"] + box["height"] * random.uniform(0.3, 0.7)
                await self._page.mouse.move(x, y, steps=random.randint(5, 15))
                await asyncio.sleep(random.uniform(0.05, 0.2))
                await self._page.mouse.click(x, y, delay=random.uniform(40, 110))
            else:
                await el.click(timeout=5000)
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("click(%s): %s", selector, exc)
            return False

    async def fill(self, selector: str, value: str) -> bool:
        try:
            el = await self._page.query_selector(selector)
            if not el:
                return False
            await el.click()
            await el.fill("")
            for ch in value:  # посимвольно, с человеческими паузами
                await self._page.keyboard.type(ch, delay=random.uniform(60, 180))
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("fill(%s): %s", selector, exc)
            return False

    async def drag(self, start: tuple[float, float], distance_px: float, *,
                   duration: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        from ..captcha.trajectory import human_track, press_delays

        try:
            mouse = self._page.mouse
            await mouse.move(start[0], start[1], steps=random.randint(6, 14))
            await asyncio.sleep(random.uniform(0.08, 0.25))
            down_delay, up_delay = press_delays()
            await mouse.down()
            await asyncio.sleep(down_delay)
            for point in human_track(start[0], start[1], distance_px, duration=duration):
                await asyncio.sleep(point.delay)
                await mouse.move(point.x, point.y)
            await asyncio.sleep(up_delay)
            await mouse.up()
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            log.warning("drag не удался: %s", exc)
            return False

    async def reload(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self._page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=45000)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("reload: %s", exc)

    async def submit_firewall_form(self, payload: str | None = None,
                                   input_selector: str = "input[name=captcha-response]") -> bool:
        """Отдаём решение так же, как это делает код самой страницы файрвола."""
        script = """([value, inputSelector]) => {
            const form = document.querySelector('form.js-firewall-form')
                      || document.querySelector('.js-firewall-form');
            if (!form) return false;
            if (value !== null) {
                const inp = form.querySelector(inputSelector) || document.querySelector(inputSelector);
                if (!inp) return false;
                inp.value = value;
            }
            form.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', {cancelable: true, bubbles: true}));
            return true;
        }"""
        return bool(await self.evaluate(script, [payload, input_selector]))


class BrowserEngine(Engine):
    name = "browser"

    def __init__(self, cfg: BrowserConfig, *, session_path: str = "data/session.json"):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.session_path = session_path
        self._pw: Any = None
        self._ctx: Any = None
        self._page: Any = None
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._allow_images = False
        self._pages_fetched = 0
        self._started_at = 0.0
        self.last_state: PageState = PageState.UNKNOWN

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
    async def start(self) -> None:
        if self._ctx is not None:
            return
        try:
            from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
        except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Playwright не установлен. Выполните: pip install playwright && playwright install chromium"
            ) from exc

        self._pw = await async_playwright().start()
        args = list(_DEFAULT_ARGS) + list(self.cfg.extra_args)
        # в контейнере под root песочница Chromium не поднимается
        if hasattr(os, "geteuid") and os.geteuid() == 0:
            args += ["--no-sandbox", "--disable-setuid-sandbox"]
        proxy = self._proxy_settings()

        if self.cfg.cdp_endpoint:
            log.info("Подключаюсь к внешнему браузеру по CDP")
            browser = await self._pw.chromium.connect_over_cdp(self.cfg.cdp_endpoint)
            self._ctx = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
        else:
            launch_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(
                user_data_dir=str(Path(self.cfg.user_data_dir).resolve()),
                headless=self.cfg.headless,
                args=args,
                ignore_default_args=["--enable-automation"],
                locale=self.cfg.locale,
                timezone_id=self.cfg.timezone,
                viewport={"width": self.cfg.viewport_width, "height": self.cfg.viewport_height},
                accept_downloads=False,
                device_scale_factor=1,
            )
            if self.cfg.user_agent:
                launch_kwargs["user_agent"] = self.cfg.user_agent
            if self.cfg.chrome_channel and self.cfg.chrome_channel != "chromium":
                launch_kwargs["channel"] = self.cfg.chrome_channel
            if proxy:
                launch_kwargs["proxy"] = proxy
            self._ctx = await self._pw.chromium.launch_persistent_context(**launch_kwargs)

        self._ctx.set_default_timeout(self.cfg.nav_timeout_sec * 1000)
        await self._ctx.add_init_script(STEALTH_JS)
        await self._ctx.route("**/*", self._route)
        self._page = self._ctx.pages[0] if self._ctx.pages else await self._ctx.new_page()
        self._started_at = time.time()
        log.info("Браузер запущен (headless=%s, proxy=%s, профиль=%s)",
                 self.cfg.headless, bool(proxy), self.cfg.user_data_dir)

    async def stop(self) -> None:
        try:
            if self._ctx is not None:
                await self.save_session(self.session_path)
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("save_session: %s", exc)
        for closer in (getattr(self._ctx, "close", None), getattr(self._pw, "stop", None)):
            if closer is None:
                continue
            try:
                await closer()
            except Exception as exc:
                log.debug("close: %s", exc)
        self._ctx = self._page = self._pw = None

    async def restart(self) -> None:
        log.info("Перезапускаю браузер (профилактика после %d страниц)", self._pages_fetched)
        await self.stop()
        self._pages_fetched = 0
        await self.start()

    def _proxy_settings(self) -> dict[str, str] | None:
        raw = (self.cfg.proxy or "").strip()
        if not raw:
            return None
        if "://" not in raw:
            raw = "http://" + raw
        parsed = urlparse(raw)
        if not parsed.hostname or not parsed.port:
            log.warning("Прокси задан некорректно, игнорирую: %s", self.cfg.proxy)
            return None
        settings = {"server": f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.hostname}:{parsed.port}"}
        if parsed.username:
            settings["username"] = parsed.username
        if parsed.password:
            settings["password"] = parsed.password
        return settings

    async def _route(self, route: Any) -> None:
        try:
            if self.cfg.block_resources and not self._allow_images:
                if route.request.resource_type in _BLOCKED_TYPES:
                    await route.abort()
                    return
            await route.continue_()
        except Exception:
            pass

    async def save_session(self, path: str) -> None:
        if self._ctx is None:
            return
        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        await self._ctx.storage_state(path=path)

    async def health(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "engine": self.name,
            "running": self._ctx is not None,
            "headless": self.cfg.headless,
            "pages_fetched": self._pages_fetched,
            "uptime_sec": round(time.time() - self._started_at, 1) if self._started_at else 0,
            "proxy": bool(self.cfg.proxy),
            "last_state": self.last_state.value,
        }

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- fetch
    async def fetch(self, url: str, *, is_item: bool = False, source_id: int | None = None,
                    captcha_handler: CaptchaHandler | None = None) -> FetchResult:
        if self._ctx is None:
            await self.start()
        if self.cfg.restart_after_pages and self._pages_fetched >= self.cfg.restart_after_pages:
            await self.restart()

        async with self._lock:  # Авито считает частоту по IP: параллелить вредно
            started = time.time()
            self._allow_images = False
            page = self._page
            status = 0
            error: str | None = None
            try:
                resp = await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded",
                                       timeout=self.cfg.nav_timeout_sec * 1000)
                status = resp.status if resp else 0
            except Exception as exc:
                error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
                log.warning("Навигация %s: %s", url, error)

            if self.cfg.humanize:
                await self._humanize(page)

            html = await self._safe_content(page)
            state = detect_state(html, http_status=status, is_item_page=is_item)
            captcha_attempts = 0

            # proof-of-work: ждём, НЕ перезагружаем (иначе проверка начнётся заново)
            if state is PageState.CHALLENGE:
                state, html = await self._wait_pow(page, status, is_item)

            while state is PageState.CAPTCHA and captcha_handler is not None:
                captcha_attempts += 1
                self._allow_images = True   # для капчи картинки нужны
                result = await captcha_handler(PlaywrightPage(page), source_id)
                if not result.solved:
                    break
                await self._settle(page)
                html = await self._safe_content(page)
                state = detect_state(html, http_status=200, is_item_page=is_item)
                if state is PageState.CAPTCHA and captcha_attempts >= 3:
                    break

            if state is PageState.UNKNOWN and error is None:
                await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
                html = await self._safe_content(page)
                state = detect_state(html, http_status=status, is_item_page=is_item)

            self._pages_fetched += 1
            self.last_state = state
            elapsed = time.time() - started
            log.info("Загружено %s → %s (%.1fs, %d байт)", url, state.value, elapsed, len(html))
            return FetchResult(url=url, html=html, status=status, state=state,
                               engine=self.name, elapsed=elapsed, error=error)

    async def _wait_pow(self, page: Any, status: int, is_item: bool) -> tuple[PageState, str]:
        deadline = time.time() + self.cfg.pow_wait_sec
        html = await self._safe_content(page)
        while time.time() < deadline:
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
            html = await self._safe_content(page)
            state = detect_state(html, http_status=200, is_item_page=is_item)
            if state is not PageState.CHALLENGE:
                log.info("Proof-of-work пройден браузером самостоятельно")
                return state, html
        log.warning("Proof-of-work не завершился за %.0fs", self.cfg.pow_wait_sec)
        return PageState.CHALLENGE, html

    async def _settle(self, page: Any) -> None:
        try:
            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=20000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        await asyncio.sleep(1.2)

    async def _humanize(self, page: Any) -> None:
        try:
            await page.mouse.move(random.randint(200, 900), random.randint(150, 600),
                                  steps=random.randint(8, 20))
            await page.evaluate(HUMANIZE_JS)
            await asyncio.sleep(random.uniform(0.4, 1.3))
        except Exception as exc:
            log.debug("humanize: %s", exc)

    async def _safe_content(self, page: Any) -> str:
        for _ in range(4):
            try:
                return await page.content()
            except Exception as exc:
                log.debug("content(): %s", exc)
                await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
        return ""

    async def open_manual(self, url: str, *, seconds: float = 600) -> None:
        """Прогрев профиля вручную: headed-браузер, вы проходите капчу/логин сами."""
        await self.start()
        await self._page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        deadline = time.time() + seconds
        while time.time() < deadline:
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
            html = await self._safe_content(self._page)
            state = detect_state(html)
            if state in (PageState.CONTENT, PageState.EMPTY):
                log.info("Профиль прошёл файрвол, сохраняю сессию")
                await self.save_session(self.session_path)
                return
        await self.save_session(self.session_path)

class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: str | Path):
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self.path), timeout=30, isolation_level=None)
        self._conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        self._conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")

    def close(self) -> None:
        try:

            pass

    @contextmanager
    def tx(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        self._conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

Без реального браузера: подставляем фейковую «живую» страницу с тем же интерфейсом,

from avito_watch.engine.browser import BrowserEngine, PlaywrightPage

from avito_watch.engine.stealth import HUMANIZE_JS, STEALTH_JS
from avito_watch.models import PageState
from tests.conftest import load_html


class FakeMouse:
    def __init__(self):
        self.moves: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
        self.downs = 0
        self.ups = 0
        self.clicks: list[tuple[float, float]] = []

    async def move(self, x, y, steps=None):
        self.moves.append((x, y))

    async def down(self):
        self.downs += 1

    async def up(self):
        self.ups += 1

    async def click(self, x, y, delay=None):
        self.clicks.append((x, y))


class FakeKeyboard:
    def __init__(self):
        self.typed: list[str] = []

    async def type(self, text, delay=None):
        self.typed.append(text)


class FakeElement:
    def __init__(self, page, selector):
        self._page = page
        self._selector = selector

    async def is_visible(self):
        return self._selector in self._page.visible

    async def bounding_box(self):
        return self._page.boxes.get(self._selector)

    async def screenshot(self, **kwargs):
        return b"element-png"

    async def click(self, **kwargs):
        self._page.clicked.append(self._selector)

    async def fill(self, value):
        self._page.filled.append((self._selector, value))


class FakeRawPage:
    """Мини-копия playwright Page: ровно то, что использует наш адаптер."""

    def __init__(self, html: str, *, url: str = "https://www.avito.ru/moskva?q=iphone",
                 content_errors: int = 0, status: int = 200):
        self._html = html
        self.url = url
        self._content_errors = content_errors
        self._status = status
        self.mouse = FakeMouse()
        self.keyboard = FakeKeyboard()
        self.visible: set[str] = set()
        self.boxes: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.clicked: list[str] = []
        self.filled: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.evaluated: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
        self.goto_calls: list[str] = []
        self.reloads = 0
        self.eval_result = True

    async def goto(self, url, **kwargs):
        self.goto_calls.append(url)
        return type("Resp", (), {"status": self._status})()

    async def content(self):
        if self._content_errors > 0:
            self._content_errors -= 1
            raise RuntimeError("Execution context was destroyed")
        return self._html

    async def screenshot(self, **kwargs):
        return b"page-png"

    async def query_selector(self, selector):
        return FakeElement(self, selector)

    async def evaluate(self, script, arg=None):
        self.evaluated.append((script, arg))
        return self.eval_result

    async def reload(self, **kwargs):
        self.reloads += 1

    async def wait_for_load_state(self, *args, **kwargs):
        return None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ прокси
@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,expected", [
    ("http://user:pass@1.2.3.4:8080", {"server": "http://1.2.3.4:8080",
                                       "username": "user", "password": "pass"}),
    ("5.6.7.8:3128", {"server": "http://5.6.7.8:3128"}),
    ("", None),
    ("мусор", None),
])
def test_proxy_settings(raw, expected):
    engine = BrowserEngine(BrowserConfig(proxy=raw))
    assert engine._proxy_settings() == expected

async def test_page_html_retries_during_navigation():
    raw = FakeRawPage(load_html("listing_state"), content_errors=2)
    page = PlaywrightPage(raw)
    assert "7654321098" in await page.html()


async def test_page_html_gives_up_quietly():
    raw = FakeRawPage("", content_errors=10)
    assert await PlaywrightPage(raw).html() == ""


async def test_page_screenshot_and_visibility():
    raw = FakeRawPage(load_html("firewall_captcha"))
    raw.visible = {".geetest_slider_button"}
    raw.boxes[".geetest_slider_button"] = {"x": 10.0, "y": 20.0, "width": 40.0, "height": 40.0}
    page = PlaywrightPage(raw)
    assert await page.screenshot() == b"page-png"
    assert await page.element_screenshot(".geetest_bg") == b"element-png"
    assert await page.is_visible(".geetest_slider_button") is True
    assert await page.is_visible(".nope") is False
    assert (await page.bounding_box(".geetest_slider_button"))["width"] == 40.0


async def test_click_lands_inside_element_not_dead_center():
    raw = FakeRawPage("<html></html>")
    raw.visible = {"button"}
    raw.boxes["button"] = {"x": 100.0, "y": 100.0, "width": 200.0, "height": 60.0}
    page = PlaywrightPage(raw)

    x, y = raw.mouse.clicks[-1]
    assert 100 < x < 300 and 100 < y < 160
    assert not (x == 200.0 and y == 130.0)      # не строго центр

    raw = FakeRawPage("<html></html>")
    page = PlaywrightPage(raw)
    assert await page.fill("#form-input", "ab12") is True
    assert raw.filled == [("#form-input", "")]

async def test_submit_firewall_form_sends_answer_to_page_code():
    raw = FakeRawPage(load_html("firewall_image"))
    page = PlaywrightPage(raw)
    assert await page.submit_firewall_form("ab12cd", "#form-input") is True
    script, arg = raw.evaluated[-1]

async def test_drag_presses_moves_and_releases():
    raw = FakeRawPage("<html></html>")

    assert await page.drag((100.0, 200.0), 180.0, duration=0.2) is True
    assert raw.mouse.downs == 1 and raw.mouse.ups == 1

async def test_static_page_cannot_solve_captcha():

    assert await page.fill("#form-input", "abc") is False
    assert await page.submit_firewall_form() is False

async def test_browser_fetch_parses_content_without_launching_browser():
    engine = BrowserEngine(BrowserConfig(humanize=True, page_delay_sec=0))
    raw = FakeRawPage(load_html("listing_state"))
    engine._ctx, engine._page = object(), raw          # браузер уже «запущен»
    result = await engine.fetch("https://www.avito.ru/moskva?q=iphone")
    assert result.state is PageState.CONTENT
    assert result.ok and result.engine == "browser"
    assert engine._pages_fetched == 1
    assert raw.goto_calls == ["https://www.avito.ru/moskva?q=iphone"]

async def test_browser_fetch_reports_captcha_and_calls_handler():
    engine = BrowserEngine(BrowserConfig(humanize=False))
    raw = FakeRawPage(load_html("firewall_captcha"))
    engine._ctx, engine._page = object(), raw
    seen: list[int | None] = []

    async def handler(page, source_id):
        from avito_watch.models import SolveResult
        seen.append(source_id)
        assert isinstance(page, PlaywrightPage)
        return SolveResult(solved=False, method="timeout")

    result = await engine.fetch("https://www.avito.ru/x", source_id=7, captcha_handler=handler)
    assert result.state is PageState.CAPTCHA
    assert seen == [7]
    assert engine._allow_images is True      # картинки для капчи разблокированы


async def test_browser_fetch_survives_navigation_error():
    engine = BrowserEngine(BrowserConfig(humanize=False))
    raw = FakeRawPage("")

    async def boom(url, **kwargs):
        raise TimeoutError("Navigation timeout")

    raw.goto = boom
    engine._ctx, engine._page = object(), raw
    result = await engine.fetch("https://www.avito.ru/x")
    assert result.error and "TimeoutError" in result.error
    assert result.state is not PageState.CONTENT


async def test_health_before_start():
    health = await BrowserEngine(BrowserConfig()).health()
    assert health["running"] is False and health["engine"] == "browser"

async def test_http_engine_loads_warm_cookies(tmp_path):
    session = tmp_path / "session.json"

    result = await engine.fetch("https://www.avito.ru/spb?q=trek")
    assert result.state is PageState.CONTENT and result.engine == "http"
    assert (await engine.health())["experimental"] is True
    await engine.stop()


def test_stealth_patches_present():
    assert "webdriver" in STEALTH_JS and "plugins" in STEALTH_JS
    assert len(HUMANIZE_JS) > 50

{"content":""""Локальный OCR капчи-картинки: предобработка, CTC и реальная офлайн-модель.

Тест с ddddocr помечен как необязательный: он проверяет, что «ИИ на своей машине»
действительно читает капчу, но не требует установки модели для обычных тестов.
"""
import io

import numpy as np
import pytest
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

from avito_watch.captcha.image_ocr import LocalOCR, _ctc_decode, preprocess_variants
from avito_watch.config import CaptchaConfig


def render_captcha(text: str, *, noise: bool = True, size=(180, 64)) -> bytes:
    """Рисуем капчу сами: шрифт берётся встроенный в Pillow, внешних файлов нет."""
    img = Image.new("RGB", size, (250, 250, 250))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    font = ImageFont.load_default(size=38)
    for i, char in enumerate(text):
        draw.text((10 + i * 26, 8 + (i % 2) * 5), char, font=font, fill=(25 + i * 8, 40, 95))
    if noise:
        for x in range(-20, size[0], 9):
            draw.line([(x, 0), (x + 24, size[1])], fill=(170, 175, 200), width=1)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, format="PNG")
    return buf.getvalue()


def test_preprocess_variants_are_valid_images():
    png = render_captcha("ab12cd")
    variants = preprocess_variants(png, count=3)
    assert len(variants) == 3
    assert variants[0] == png                       # оригинал всегда первый
    for variant in variants:
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(variant)) as img:
            img.load()
            assert img.width > 0


def test_preprocess_survives_garbage():
    assert preprocess_variants(b"не картинка", 3) == [b"не картинка"]


def test_preprocess_respects_count():
    assert len(preprocess_variants(render_captcha("x9f3"), count=1)) == 1


def test_ctc_decode_collapses_repeats_and_drops_blank():
    charset = "0123456789"                 # blank = последний индекс (9)
    # a a 0 1 1 blank 2 → "012"
    rows = [[0] * 10 for _ in range(7)]
    for step, idx in enumerate([0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 9, 2]):
        rows[step][idx] = 1.0
    assert _ctc_decode(np.array([rows], dtype="float32"), charset) == "012"


def test_ctc_decode_handles_bad_shape():
    assert _ctc_decode(np.zeros((5,), dtype="float32"), "abc") == ""


def test_backend_none_is_honest():
    ocr = LocalOCR(CaptchaConfig(ocr_backend="none"))
    assert ocr.available is False and ocr.backend == "none"
    assert ocr.recognize(render_captcha("ab12cd")) == []


def test_missing_onnx_model_does_not_crash(tmp_path):
    ocr = LocalOCR(CaptchaConfig(ocr_backend="onnx",
                                 onnx_model_path=str(tmp_path / "нет-такой.onnx")))
    assert ocr.available is False


def test_candidates_are_deduped_and_sorted(monkeypatch):
    ocr = LocalOCR(CaptchaConfig(ocr_backend="none"))
    ocr._backend = "fake"                            # притворяемся, что модель есть
    answers = iter(["toolonganswer", "ab12", "ab12", "x9"])
    monkeypatch.setattr(ocr, "_run", lambda png: next(answers, ""))
    monkeypatch.setattr("avito_watch.captcha.image_ocr.preprocess_variants",
                        lambda png, count: [png] * 4)
    candidates = ocr.recognize(b"png")
    assert candidates[0] == "ab12"                   # 4-6 символов — самые вероятные
    assert candidates.count("ab12") == 1             # дубли убраны
    assert "toolonganswer" in candidates


def test_normalize_strips_junk(monkeypatch):
    ocr = LocalOCR(CaptchaConfig(ocr_backend="none"))
    assert ocr._normalize(" A B-1_2! ") == "ab12"
    assert ocr._normalize(None) == ""


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["ab12cd", "7k4m2", "x9f3", "82hd"])
def test_real_local_model_reads_captcha(text):
    """Главное обещание проекта: капча-картинка решается ЛОКАЛЬНО, без сервисов."""
    pytest.importorskip("ddddocr", reason="локальная модель не установлена (requirements-ocr.txt)")
    ocr = LocalOCR(CaptchaConfig(ocr_backend="auto"))
    if ocr.backend != "ddddocr":
        pytest.skip(f"доступен другой бэкенд: {ocr.backend}")
    candidates = ocr.recognize(render_captcha(text))
    assert text in candidates, f"ожидали {text}, модель дала {candidates}"

import pytest

from avito_watch.bot.commands import BotController
from avito_watch.captcha.manual import ManualCenter
from avito_watch.models import CaptchaVariant, SourceStatus
from avito_watch.pipeline import Pipeline
from avito_watch.watcher import Watcher

URL = "https://www.avito.ru/moskva?q=iphone"


@pytest.fixture
def manual():
    return ManualCenter()


@pytest.fixture
def bot(cfg, db, fake_engine, fake_telegram, manual):
    pipeline = Pipeline(cfg, db, fake_engine, fake_telegram)
    watcher = Watcher(cfg, db, fake_engine, fake_telegram, pipeline, manual=manual)

def message(text: str, chat_id: str = "100500", user_id: str = "100500", **extra) -> dict:

def callback(data: str, chat_id: str = "100500", user_id: str = "100500") -> dict:
    return {"update_id": 2, "callback_query": {"id": "cb1", "data": data,
                                              "from": {"id": user_id},
                                              "message": {"chat": {"id": chat_id}}}}

########## Dockerfile
# Avito Watch: браузер + локальный OCR + noVNC для ручного прохождения капчи.
FROM python:3.11-slim-bookworm

ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    DISPLAY=:99 \
    AW_PROFILE_DIR=/app/data/profile \
    AW_DB_PATH=/app/data/avito.db

# Системные зависимости: Xvfb + x11vnc + noVNC (чтобы вы могли пройти капчу руками
# из браузера телефона), шрифты и утилиты.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      xvfb x11vnc novnc websockify \
      fonts-liberation fonts-dejavu-core \
      ca-certificates curl tini procps \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt requirements-ocr.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-ocr.txt || \
       echo "OCR-пакеты не установились — капча-картинка будет решаться вручную"

# Браузер и его системные зависимости
RUN playwright install --with-deps chromium && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY avito_watch ./avito_watch
COPY config.example.yaml ./config.example.yaml
COPY docker/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh && mkdir -p /app/data

VOLUME ["/app/data"]
EXPOSE 6080

HEALTHCHECK --interval=60s --timeout=10s --start-period=90s --retries=3 \
  CMD python -c "import json,time,sys; d=json.load(open('/app/data/heartbeat.json')); sys.exit(0 if time.time()-d['ts'] < 300 else 1)" || exit 1

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "--", "/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["python", "-m", "avito_watch", "run"]########## docker-compose.yml
services:
  avito-watch:
    build: .
    container_name: avito-watch
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file: .env
    environment:
      # Браузер «видимый» внутри Xvfb — чтобы вы могли пройти капчу через noVNC.
      AW_HEADLESS: "0"
      AW_MANUAL_URL: "${AW_MANUAL_URL:-http://localhost:6080/vnc.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale}"
      VNC_PASSWORD: "${VNC_PASSWORD:-}"
      TZ: "Europe/Moscow"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data                 # БД, профиль браузера, логи, скриншоты капчи
      - ./config.yaml:/app/config.yaml   # ваши ссылки и настройки
    ports:
      # noVNC только на localhost машины. Для доступа с телефона/VPS:
      # замените на "6080:6080" и ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО задайте VNC_PASSWORD в .env
      - "127.0.0.1:6080:6080"
    shm_size: "1gb"                      # Chromium не любит маленький /dev/shm
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"########## docker/entrypoint.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Запуск Avito Watch в контейнере.
# По умолчанию браузер работает «headed» внутри виртуального дисплея Xvfb:
# так вы в любой момент можете открыть noVNC и пройти капчу руками.
set -euo pipefail

APP_DIR="${APP_DIR:-/app}"
cd "$APP_DIR"
mkdir -p data data/profile data/captcha

if [[ ! -f config.yaml ]]; then
  cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
  echo "[entrypoint] Создан config.yaml из примера — отредактируйте sources под себя"
fi

HEADLESS="${AW_HEADLESS:-0}"
VNC_PORT="${VNC_PORT:-6080}"
VNC_PASSWORD="${VNC_PASSWORD:-}"

if [[ "$HEADLESS" == "0" || "$HEADLESS" == "false" ]]; then
  echo "[entrypoint] Поднимаю виртуальный дисплей :99"
  Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1440x900x24 -nolisten tcp &
  sleep 2

  VNC_ARGS=(-display :99 -forever -shared -rfbport 5900 -noxdamage -quiet)
  if [[ -n "$VNC_PASSWORD" ]]; then
    VNC_ARGS+=(-passwd "$VNC_PASSWORD")
  else
    echo "[entrypoint] ВНИМАНИЕ: VNC без пароля. Задайте VNC_PASSWORD в .env или закройте порт наружу."
    VNC_ARGS+=(-nopw)
  fi
  x11vnc "${VNC_ARGS[@]}" &
  sleep 1

  websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc "$VNC_PORT" localhost:5900 &
  echo "[entrypoint] noVNC: http://localhost:${VNC_PORT}/vnc.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale"
  export DISPLAY=:99
else
  echo "[entrypoint] Headless-режим: ручное прохождение капчи через noVNC недоступно"
fi

# Чистим зависший лок профиля после некорректной остановки контейнера
rm -f data/profile/SingletonLock data/profile/SingletonCookie data/profile/SingletonSocket 2>/dev/null || true

exec "$@"########## .env.example
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Avito Watch — секреты. Скопируйте в .env и заполните.
#   cp .env.example .env
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Токен бота от @BotFather
AW_TELEGRAM_TOKEN=123456789:AAExxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

# Куда слать объявления. Проще всего: оставьте пустым, напишите боту /start —
# он покажет и запомнит ваш chat_id. Для канала: -1001234567890
AW_CHAT_ID=

# Кто может управлять ботом (через запятую). Пусто = только AW_CHAT_ID
AW_ADMIN_IDS=

# ── Браузер ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1 — без окна (сервер/Docker), 0 — видеть браузер глазами (удобно для капчи)
AW_HEADLESS=1
AW_PROFILE_DIR=data/profile
AW_ENGINE=browser

# Резидентный RU-прокси с ЛИПКОЙ сессией (один IP на весь профиль).
# Формат: http://user:pass@host:port  — пусто = ваш собственный IP
AW_PROXY=

# ── Интервалы ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Интервал обновления по умолчанию, секунды (для каждой ссылки можно свой)
AW_INTERVAL=300
# Сколько страниц выдачи читать за проход
AW_PAGES=1
# Заходить на страницу объявления за описанием и точной датой
AW_ENRICH=1
# Первый проход только фиксирует текущие объявления (без спама в чат)
AW_SEED_EXISTING=1

# ── Капча ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Пробовать решить локально (OpenCV / локальная OCR-модель)
AW_CAPTCHA_AUTO=1
# auto | ddddocr | onnx | none
AW_OCR_BACKEND=auto
# Сколько ждать ручного решения, прежде чем поставить источник на паузу
AW_CAPTCHA_MANUAL_WAIT=1800
# Ссылка, которую бот пришлёт кнопкой «Открыть браузер» (noVNC в Docker)
# Пример: http://192.168.1.50:6080/vnc.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale
AW_MANUAL_URL=

# ── Прочее ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
AW_DB_PATH=data/avito.db
AW_LOG_LEVEL=INFO########## config.example.yaml
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Avito Watch — конфигурация. Скопируйте: cp config.example.yaml config.yaml
# Секреты (токен, chat_id, прокси) держите в .env — они перекрывают YAML.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

telegram:
  enabled: true
  send_photos: true
  description_limit: 700        # сколько символов описания влезает в подпись к фото
  full_description: false       # true = полное описание отдельным сообщением
  notify_price_drop: true       # сообщать о снижении цены у уже найденных объявлений
  price_drop_min_pct: 5
  commands_enabled: true        # управление ботом: /add, /pause, /interval, ...
  silent_hours: ""              # '23:00-08:00' — сообщения без звука

browser:
  engine: browser               # browser (надёжно) | http (экспериментально, только с прогретой сессией)
  headless: true                # в Docker рекомендуется false + Xvfb/noVNC
  user_data_dir: data/profile   # здесь живут cookies файрвола — не удаляйте
  locale: ru-RU
  timezone: Europe/Moscow
  viewport_width: 1440
  viewport_height: 900
  nav_timeout_sec: 45
  pow_wait_sec: 30              # proof-of-work: ждём, НЕ перезагружаем страницу
  block_resources: true         # не грузить картинки/шрифты на выдаче (быстрее и меньше трафика)
  humanize: true                # движения мыши, скролл, паузы
  page_delay_sec: 3             # пауза между страницами одного источника
  restart_after_pages: 120      # профилактический перезапуск браузера
  cdp_endpoint: ""              # внешний браузер по CDP, если используете

captcha:
  auto_solve: true              # локальные попытки без внешних сервисов
  max_auto_attempts: 2
  notify: true                  # ВСЕГДА сообщать вам о капче
  notify_cooldown_sec: 300
  manual_wait_sec: 1800         # 30 минут ждём вас, потом пауза источника
  poll_interval_sec: 5
  pause_source_on_captcha: true
  ocr_backend: auto             # auto | ddddocr | onnx | none
  onnx_model_path: models/captcha.onnx
  onnx_charset: "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
  ocr_variants: 3
  save_samples: true            # копить датасет ваших ответов для дообучения

"""Конфигурация: config.yaml + переменные окружения (.env).

Приоритет: значения по умолчанию < config.yaml < переменные окружения.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, fields, is_dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import yaml

ENV_PREFIX = "AW_"


def _env(name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    return os.environ.get(name, default)


def _as_bool(value: Any) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    return str(value).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "yes", "on", "да")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return []
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [str(v).strip() for v in value if str(v).strip()]
    return [p.strip() for p in str(value).split(",") if p.strip()]
